_metadata.description: Per-jurisdiction matrix of NON-sales-tax obligations relevant to a remote ecommerce seller (FBA + Shopify): gross-receipts and business-activity taxes, entity franchise taxes, and qualification-driven annual reports. Sales-tax returns are NOT in scope — those live in filing_calendar.
_metadata.disclaimer: Monitoring aid only. Not legal or tax advice.

status_values.verified_applies: An obligation was verified against an official source. See obligations[].
status_values.verified_none: Verified that no non-sales-tax obligation arises for a remote seller. NOT USED YET — no state has been affirmatively cleared.
status_values.not_researched: No verification performed. MUST NOT be read as 'nothing required'.

trigger_values.qualification: Arises only from registering the entity with the Secretary of State (foreign qualification or domestic formation). Sales-tax registration alone NEVER creates one.
trigger_values.inventory / property nexus: Can arise from holding inventory in the state, e.g. FBA stock.
trigger_values.economic: Arises from crossing a revenue/activity threshold, independent of physical presence.
trigger_values.sales-tax registration: Arises because the seller is registered to collect in that state.

mode_values.schedulable: Follows from a fact in entity_profile.json; gets real due dates.
mode_values.review_only: Turns on a contested legal position; never auto-scheduled. Enable via enabled_obligations after a CPA confirms.

_metadata.important: PL 86-272 protects only against net-income taxes. It does NOT protect against gross-receipts or business-activity taxes such as WA B&O, OH CAT, OR CAT, TX franchise or DE GRT — which is why those appear here for remote sellers with no offices or staff in the state.

obligations.name: LLC annual franchise tax ($800 minimum)
obligations.note: FTB treats FBA inventory storage as 'doing business'; OTA has sustained it. Administered by FTB, not CDTFA — a sales-tax registration does not address it.

obligations.name: Gross Receipts Tax + business license
obligations.note: DE has no sales tax but taxes the SELLER's gross receipts. Nexus is created by property in DE including inventory and warehouses. A retail/wholesale licence is also required.

obligations.name: LLC annual tax ($300)
obligations.note: Flat $300 due June 1; no annual report required for LLCs. Only once formed or registered in DE.

obligations.name: Corporate Activity Tax (CAT)
obligations.note: Registration required within 30 days of exceeding $750,000 Oregon commercial activity; tax ($250 + 0.57%) applies above $1M. Registration duty starts BELOW the tax threshold.
